## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 20 jul 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _jesse p_, 20 jul 2026, 3/5: "wird keinen design award gewinnen. keine werbung, alles nutzbar ohne paywall. WYSIWYG! von daher toll und hebt sich enorm von konkurrenten ab, habe kein gleichwertiges produkt gefunden. da man pro habit nicht für mehrmals pro tag tracken kann, für mich nicht verwendbar."
            2. _Arnav Singh_, 2 sept 2026, 5/5: "Amazing app. No complex settings and features like other apps, no paid subscription, no ads, no locked features etc. Just raw habit tracker, with basic useful features, offline, clean ui and fast and reliable. Amazing.🤌🏻. EDIT - Would love if there was a web version of this app, making it available to ios, windows and other platforms."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      1 reseña reciente menciona errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 29 sept 2026 - 29 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Aarjav Dua_, 29 sept 2026, 5/5: "Could you please please please add an option to group habits under a folder and have them open like a drop down folder, that shows sub grouped items upon clicking the folder? pleasee. otherwise good app. Also there is a glitch while using the notes section of a habit. When the notes section is long, it gets hidden because of the onscreen keyboard while using it. please fix it. also can we get a daily score on top of the habits that we did today and also the consistency graph for the same?"
<!--/ir-theme-->
